The big near term catalyst is the upcoming Q3 FY27 earnings update and outlook. This should give you a clearer read on Atlas consumption and AI workload traction.

The biggest immediate risk is execution. Recent leadership changes, new AI tools that have not yet delivered the uplift some investors wanted, and strong NoSQL rivals from hyperscalers all put pressure on pricing, margins and product delivery. Marathon Petroleum (MPC)

Marathon Petroleum runs a large US focused downstream operation that refines and markets fuels, supported by a Midstream unit that owns pipelines, storage and logistics tied directly to higher throughput demand from easier permitting. Pipelines and storage facilities will be critical to moving larger volumes of oil and gas efficiently, especially with the renewed emphasis on LNG exports to meet global demand."

Kinder Morgan is a Houston based energy infrastructure operator whose core link to the theme is its US natural gas and refined products pipelines, storage and LNG facilities.
